# Swoon Plans

> Swoon Plans is a date planning service at makeherswoon.com that builds complete
> date night itineraries. You answer 20 short multiple-choice questions about your
> partner, and Swoon Plans returns a full evening plan with real venues, exact
> addresses, phone numbers, and direct reservation links. The first plan is free
> and requires no payment method.

## What it is

Swoon Plans is a self-serve date planning tool, not a human concierge and not a
booking agent. It generates the itinerary; you make the reservations yourself using
the links provided. Swoon Plans is a division of For Love Coaching.

## Who it is for

Husbands, boyfriends, and fiances who want to plan a memorable date without spending
hours researching venues. Common use cases: anniversaries, birthdays, proposals, and
last-minute plans. The Command tier is used by professional concierges and planners.

## How it works

1. Answer 20 short tap-through questions about her tastes, vibe, dietary needs, and schedule.
2. Receive a complete itinerary with real venues, exact addresses, and timing.
3. Book directly through the reservation links. Swap any stop you do not like.

## Coverage

Swoon Plans covers 20 United States metro areas:

- Washington, D.C. / Arlington
- New York, NY
- Los Angeles, CA
- Chicago, IL
- Miami, FL
- Atlanta, GA
- Boston, MA
- San Francisco, CA
- Austin, TX
- Dallas-Fort Worth, TX
- Charlotte, NC
- Raleigh-Durham, NC
- Nashville, TN
- Philadelphia, PA
- Houston, TX
- Phoenix, AZ
- Seattle, WA
- Tampa, FL
- Minneapolis-St. Paul, MN
- Denver, CO

## Pricing

- Starter, $11.87/month: 1 saved date profile, unlimited date plans for her, real venues with addresses and phone numbers, direct reservation links, swap any stop.
- Operator, $32.50/month: up to 3 saved date profiles, everything in Starter, text or share the finished plan, priority venue matching.
- Command, $197/month: unlimited saved date profiles, everything in Operator, priority support.
- First date plan is free, no card required. Billed monthly in USD, renews automatically, cancel anytime with access through the paid period.

## What Swoon Plans is not

- Not a reservation platform. It does not take payment on behalf of venues.
- Not affiliated with any venue it recommends.
- Not a human matchmaking or dating service.
- Not a coaching service, though its parent company For Love Coaching does relationship coaching.
